findings: All T15–T16 changes applied and verified on master (commit 100d767). Key facts for later FEAT steps: (1) train_test_split is no longer imported or used in training_simple.py — chronological 80/20 split is now used in _evaluar_individuo. (2) Baseline accuracy (majority-class frequency) is printed for both 'result' and 'series' models after training, but only when verbose=True. (3) The verification command in FEAT-002.json uses open() without encoding — on Windows with cp1252 default this fails due to UTF-8 characters (★, ←) in the file; the actual check passes when encoding='utf-8' is specified. FEAT-003 should be aware of this if it runs similar file-content checks.
